The numbers $a_1,\dots,a_N$ are its partial quotients, and $\frac{p_n}{q_n}=[a_0,\dots,a_n]$ is the $n$-th convergent. Infinite continued fractions $[a_0,a_1,a_2,\dots]$ are also allowed (assume they converge); an overline over a block of partial quotients means that the block repeats forever.
